messages.author: 72f2ccabe1e5089f
messages.subject: Warning message from openCR.fit
parts:
Hi
I understand that one can pass openCR.fit a multisession (MS) capthist object which internally gets stacked into a single-session type of object with join(). But I have noticed that openCR.fit() gives a warning message about a MS capthist object being passed (saying that only the 1st session is used) whereas this warning does not appear when using par.openCR.fit() to fit more than one model.

I can see from the intervals attribute of the model object produced by openCR.fit() that all looks fine i.e. it does seem to have used all the sessions correctly. Please can I just confirm that the warning message is a red herring?

Many thanks

Greg

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Warning message from openCR.fit
parts:
Hi
I get no warning with openCR.fit(ovenCHp). The only such message I can find is
"multi-session mask provided; using first"
which should be taken seriously: openCR.fit does not allow session-specific masks.
Murray
